example: If you ask me, the blue jacket looks better.

examples.highlight: If you ask me, the blue jacket looks better.

rules.zh: 核心表達固定為 if + you + ask + me，四個部分的次序不可改變；ask 後面直接接受格 me，不加 to，也不加入 will。
rules.en: if + you + ask me if you ask to me if you will ask me if you ask my opinion me if ask me

rules.zh: 後不需要使用 to 因為 ask someone 後面直接接人，不使用 to。
rules.en: ask If you ask me, this route is safer. If you ask to me, this route is safer.

rules.zh: 這裏通常不是一個真正的條件句在以下句子中：【If you ask me, the plan is too expensive.】 說話者並不是等待對方真的提出問題。整個表達的實際意思是：【In my opinion, the plan is too expensive.】 因此，不要把它理解為普通的「如果……便……」條件句。
rules.en: If you ask me, the plan is too expensive. In my opinion, the plan is too expensive.

rules.zh: 前後必須有完整意見目標表達【If you ask me】本身不能表達完整意見。
rules.en: If you ask me Incomplete: If you ask me. Complete: If you ask me, the plan needs more work. Complete: The plan needs more work, if you ask me.

rules.zh: 當 If you ask me 放在句首時，後面要加逗號，再接完整意見；不可省略這個分隔逗號。
rules.en: If you ask me, we should leave now. If you ask me we should leave now.

rules.zh: 句尾形式前面使用逗號逗號把主要意見與附加評論分開。
rules.en: We should leave now, if you ask me.

rules.zh: 插入句中時，前後均使用逗號兩個逗號顯示 if you ask me 是插入成分。
rules.en: The first option, if you ask me, is too expensive.

rules.zh: 不要因為有 ask 而使用問號雖然 ask 與提問有關，但整句通常是一個陳述句。
rules.en: If you ask me, the film was too long. If you ask me? The film was too long.

rules.zh: 在表達個人看法時，If you ask me 可引出評價、建議、比較、預測和批評。它既可放在句首，也可作句中或句末插入語；無論位置如何，後面的內容都應是完整、清楚而真正屬於說話者的看法。
rules.en: If you ask me, the book is excellent. If you ask me, you should apologise. The second design, if you ask me, is more attractive. The team will probably win, if you ask me. If you ask me, the decision was completely unfair.

rules.zh: 語氣較口語和直接常見於：日常對話討論訪問個人評論非正式文章對話式演講它可以用於一般寫作，但在非常正式的學術論文中，通常會使用：【in my view；it may be argued that；the evidence suggests that】
rules.en: If you ask me in my view it may be argued that the evidence suggests that

rules.zh: 有時會帶有較強烈的個人判斷比較：【I think the plan is unwise.】 第二句往往聽起來更像說話者正在坦率地表達自己的判斷，尤其是在提出批評時。因此，使用時仍需留意語氣。
rules.en: I think the plan is unwise. If you ask me, the plan is unwise.

rules.zh: 本課不包括以下延伸形式以下形式與目標句型意思相近，但不是本課的核心答案：【if you were to ask me；if anyone asks me；if you want my opinion；if you ask for my opinion；since you ask me】 所有練習答案均須使用：【if you ask me】
rules.en: if you were to ask me if anyone asks me if you want my opinion if you ask for my opinion since you ask me if you ask me

benefits.zh: 清楚表明這是個人看法這個句型能幫助你分開「事實」和「個人判斷」。旅程需時兩小時。 這較像客觀資料。依我看，這段旅程太長了。 這清楚表示「太長」是說話者的個人評價。
benefits.en: The journey takes two hours. If you ask me, the journey is too long.

benefits.zh: 能自然地加入建議或評論當別人正在討論選擇、問題或計劃時，你可以用這個句型自然地加入自己的意見。依我看，我們應該選擇較便宜的方案。 它特別適合對話、討論和口語考試。
benefits.en: If you ask me, we should choose the cheaper option.

benefits.zh: 不需要每次都使用 I think 學生經常重複使用：【I think...；I think...；I think...】 使用 if you ask me，可以用另一種自然方式表達意見。可以改為：【If you ask me, the room is too small.】 這令說話和寫作不會過度重複同一個開頭。
benefits.en: I think... I think the room is too small. If you ask me, the room is too small.

benefits.zh: 可以放在不同位置這個句型不一定要放在句首。不同位置能讓學生改變句子結構，避免每一句都以相同方式開始。
benefits.en: If you ask me, the plan is too risky. The plan is too risky, if you ask me. The plan, if you ask me, is too risky.

benefits.zh: 能讓意見聽起來更直接和有個人特色有「要我說的話」的感覺。它適合表達：明確選擇個人偏好實際建議坦率批評對某件事的評價要我說的話，第一個解決方法只能暫時解決問題。
benefits.en: If you ask me If you ask me, the first solution is only a temporary fix.

benefits.zh: 可以作為即時口語句框在討論或口語考試中，學生不需要從零開始組織整句。可以先使用：【If you ask me,...】 然後加入自己的觀點：【If you ask me, we should...；If you ask me, this is...；If you ask me, the best option is...；If you ask me, it would be better to...】 這個句框能給學生短暫的思考時間，同時自然地開始回答。
benefits.en: If you ask me,... If you ask me, we should... If you ask me, this is... If you ask me, the best option is... If you ask me, it would be better to...
